players.product: Ceramic packages (LCC and butterfly types) for laser diodes and optical devices, incl. optical communications (NTK CERAMIC)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): revenue JPY 351,171 million (+8.2% year on year), operating profit JPY 71,991 million (-0.4%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 53,756 million (+6.7%). Automotive revenue JPY 285,202 million (+5.3%) and operating profit JPY 70,654 million (-1.8%), mainly on yen appreciation; Components & Solutions revenue JPY 61,413 million (+23.2%) and operating profit JPY 720 million (vs. a JPY 1,188 million loss a year earlier), on higher SPE demand for generative-AI applications, firm sales for advanced logic semiconductors and the newly consolidated Niterra Materials.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue JPY 351,171 million (+8.2%); Components & Solutions revenue JPY 61,413 million (+23.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management states that in the semiconductor manufacturing equipment industry demand is expected to expand over the medium to long term for generative AI and data centers, but in H1 FY2026 there were temporary moves to rebalance supply and demand, such as deferred capital investment.
